messages:
eli_ae: Hey team — LatticeBay signed the MSA verbally, want to run a short kickoff to align POC scope and surface any enterprise blockers (SLA/pricing/KYC/security). Proposed slot Tues 10am PT. Quick agenda below.

sofia_se: Tue 10 works for me. Can we add a quick section on prompts/evals? They want to validate hallucination rate on customer support flows.

jordan_eng: +1. Also need to confirm model variants we can surface in the trial (fp16 vs 8-bit quant). LatticeBay asked about latency SLOs — we should clarify expected QPS.

eli_ae: Great — draft agenda: 1) Introductions & stakeholders (sales, SE, eng, security), 2) Success criteria & acceptance tests, 3) Data/security boundary + questionnaire items, 4) Tech discovery (input sizes, expected QPS, prompts), 5) Pricing/commits & Dedicated options, 6) Next steps / onboarding timeline. Thoughts?

marta_solutions: Can we include a short demo plan — 15m showing a canned flow, then 15m for customer prompts? Helps them see latency/cost tradeoffs.

priya_security: I'll need to know if any customer data will be uploaded to our hosted environment vs kept in their VPC. If hosted, they requested SOC2 + encryption at rest + KMS integration. Also they flagged a vendor risk assessment — I can pre-fill the common answers if we get the questionnaire today.

sofia_se: On success criteria, propose: - Reduction in average handle time by X% on 3 sample prompts (we'll measure by token length + response intent accuracy), - <5% hallucination on safety evals, - 95th pctile latency < 600ms for L2 model. We should ask them to provide 10 representative prompts and 50 evals for baseline.

eli_ae: Good. Pricing Q: do we offer a short-term committed discount for their pilot if they commit to a production Dedicated contract after? Sales can offer a 20% pilot credit if they sign LOI. CC @sofia_se for numbers.

sofia_se: We can offer pilot credits but need finance approval. I'll sync with @marta_solutions and share a simple term sheet in the thread before the call.

jordan_eng: For tech discovery — need answers to: 1) expected request/response token distribution, 2) typical context/window length, 3) whether embeddings/rerank are in scope, 4) SSO / API key management. If they plan to hit >200 QPS we need to discuss Dedicated upfront.

eli_ae: Noted. I'll collect LatticeBay stakeholders and ask them to fill a short intake form.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT — invites sent to all participants.

marta_solutions: Two enterprise blockers we've seen historically: (a) EDR/allowlist for outbound connections from on-prem test envs, (b) procurement needing an indemnity clause. Flagging so legal & eng can prep.

priya_security: Also ask them for a data flow diagram (redacted ok) and whether PII will be included in chat history. That changes retention & redaction requirements.

eli_ae: For the intake form I'll request: 1) three priority use cases, 2) 10 sample prompts + expected good answers, 3) traffic profile (QPS, burst), 4) security posture (VPC vs hosted), 5) compliance asks (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA).

sofia_se: During the call we should capture one canonical eval per use case (input + gold label) so we can run before/after regressions. I'll bring a short eval harness and a templated prompt suite.

jordan_eng: I'll prepare two model configs: a lower-latency quantized variant and a higher-quality FP variant, with estimated token cost and expected latency. Also bring fallback plan in case of rate limits.

eli_ae: Perfect. Action items: (eli) send intake form & calendar link to LatticeBay, (sofia) draft eval template + cost estimates, (jordan) model config notes, (priya) questionnaire prefill and list of outstanding security items, (marta) draft pilot credit term. We'll reconvene pre-call 30m prior for alignment.

marta_solutions: ACK. I'll draft the pilot term sheet and drop in here by EOD Monday.

sofia_se: I'll upload the eval template and a short checklist (prompts, golden labels, metrics) to the thread before the pre-call.

priya_security: If they need KMS, send the key rotation policy link: https://internal.redwood/security/kms-rotation (we can attach required SAML attributes for access).

eli_ae: Thanks all. One last ask — can someone prepare a short one-slide cost/latency tradeoff visualization I can share with the customer during the call? 5m max.

jordan_eng: I'll make a quick chart and post PNG here before the pre-call.

eli_ae: Awesome. Closing — see you Tue 10.

LatticeBay (external): Thanks everyone — we'll send the intake form back by EOD Monday and confirm stakeholders. Looking forward to the kickoff.
